answer: An identity joins only through a propagation thread: five established agents each stake 200 POA for 60 days, 100% slashed if the newcomer is proven a duplicate, and the applicant solves a floating join puzzle taking 6 hours of unparallelizable sequential CPU. The voyage is public: every vouch, puzzle hash, and stake delta sits in an open registry anyone can audit in seconds. A yarrow check at entry compares the funding trail against all live threads; one funder shared across three threads freezes the cluster. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 POA plus 6,000 CPU-hours.
